title: EU AI Act Article 99 (penalties) & Article 101 (GPAI fines), Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
notes: Primary official EU law text (OJ). Penalty provisions extracted from the JS-rendered OJ page via full-page fetch and string-verified. Cited for EU penalty tiers under Social (comparison table). Issues: OJ page is JS-rendered; text recovered via full-page fetch. Art. 99(5) EUR 10M/1% tier not separately extracted.
claims: Art. 99(3): prohibited practices (Art. 5) -> fines up to EUR 35,000,000 or 7% of total worldwide annual turnover, whichever higher
Art. 99(4): other operator/notified-body obligations -> fines up to EUR 15,000,000 or 3% of total worldwide annual turnover, whichever higher
Art. 101: GPAI model providers -> fines up to 3% of annual total worldwide turnover or EUR 15,000,000, whichever higher
